name: Download Icon
description: Arrow bounces into the tray on click — click-triggered download feedback icon

variations.name: default
variations.description: Arrow translates down into the tray and snaps back on click

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Stroke width of the icon paths

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Triggers the arrow bounce. Set true on click, reset after 200ms.
